base: Reference-preserving extraction for an animation keyframe. Isolate ONLY the {POS} character ({NAME}) from the supplied character lineup. The supplied image is the EDIT TARGET, not inspiration. Preserve the original drawing's exact character design, face, expression, pose, headwear, every visible garment's color blocking, ink line style, costume ornaments and accessories; do not redesign, beautify or invent a new pose. Remove the other two characters and ALL titles, labels, dates and lettering. Return a single full-body character centered on the same warm ivory paper backdrop, portrait 2:3 canvas, preferably 1024x1536. Character occupies 82% of canvas height with generous clean margins above the headpiece and below the feet; full character from tallest headpiece to shoe soles is visible. Keep the body center at horizontal center, with feet on a consistent floor line around 92% canvas height, no border, no text. Maintain hand-drawn Hong Kong/Taiwan wuxia comic 2D style. Not 3D, not realistic photo, not chibi. No extra characters, no collage and no extra props. The resulting keyframe will be used unchanged as an animation first/last frame.
